description: This file defines a service for retrieving and aggregating the total cost of Large Language Model (LLM) usage by agent. It includes functions to resolve database collection candidates, build MongoDB aggregation pipelines for different data schemas, and perform fallback in-application aggregation if database-level queries fail. The core method getLlmCostByAgent performs the main logic of fetching and processing the data for API responses.

methods.name: resolveCollectionCandidates()
methods.description: Determines the list of collection names to query based on environment variables and default priorities, supporting single or comma-separated collection names.

methods.name: buildFlatAgentCostPipeline()
methods.description: Constructs a MongoDB aggregation pipeline to process documents with flat schema, extracting agent and cost information, normalizing agent names for case-insensitive grouping, and summing costs.

methods.name: buildAgentsArrayPipeline()
methods.description: Constructs a MongoDB aggregation pipeline for documents where agents are stored as an array of objects, to extract, normalize, and sum agent costs similarly to the flat schema.

methods.name: aggregateAgentsInApp(documents = [])
methods.description: Performs in-memory aggregation over an array of documents with Agents[] schema as a fallback mechanism when database aggregation pipelines fail or produce no data.

methods.name: getLlmCostByAgent()
methods.description: Main exported async function that attempts to retrieve aggregated LLM costs by agent from the database. It tries the primary aggregation pipeline, then a secondary one, and finally falls back to in-memory aggregation if needed.
